description: Two firms side by side. Reports each figure with its evidence state and whether the pair is comparable at all: a field neither firm records is not a tie, and a field only one records is not a win. No per-field winner is declared, because the direction of "better" for several of these is a judgement the published scoring model already makes; each firm's grade is returned alongside so the verdict comes from that model rather than from this tool.
name: compare_firms
